candidate.educational_objective: Identify the expected resting respiratory-rate range of a healthy newborn.
candidate.rationale: Current NCBI Nursing Health Promotion guidance lists a normal respiratory rate of 30 to 60 breaths/min for a newborn from birth to 1 month. Respirations should be assessed when the newborn is calm because crying, sleep state, and other factors can alter the observed rate. B is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: The normal respiratory-rate range for newborns to 1 month is 30–60 breaths per minute.
